newsitem.title: JAPAN: CALSONIC TO FORM SAFRICA CAR PARTS VENTURE.
newsitem.headline: CALSONIC TO FORM SAFRICA CAR PARTS VENTURE.

text.p: Auto parts maker Calsonic Corp said on Friday it had agreed to form a joint venture to produce car components in South Africa with South Korea's SJM Co Ltd.
The joint venture, Calsonic South Africa Pty Ltd (CSA), will be based in Port Elizabeth and capitalised at five million rands, or about 150 million yen, a Calsonic spokesman said.
Calsonic's European unit, Calsonic International Europe will take a 51 percent stake in the venture, while the rest will be held by SJM Co Ltd, a maker of flexible tubes.
Production of flexible tubes, a component in exhaust systems, will begin in the third quarter of this year at a rate of 200,000 units a year.
The tubes will be supplied to Adam Opel AG, a German unit of General Motors Corp (GM).
The formation of the joint venture was in response to a request from General Motors, which wants to cut production costs at its South African unit, Calsonic said.
Calsonic is owned 33.3 percent by Nissan Motor Co Ltd.
